title: TIMERSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19725v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series foundation models provide strong zero-shot forecast, but deployment for real- world applications still requires task-specific designs for model inputs and outputs. Direct inference can leave domain knowledge and re- curring forecast errors unaddressed, while tai- lored pipelines require substantial human ex- pertise and effort. We introduce TIMERSI, a self-improving agentic deployment system around frozen forecasting models. A cod- ing agent translates task descriptions into ex- ecutable pipeline changes. It tests each re- vision on historical forecasting windows and uses observed errors to guide subsequent re- visions. During deployment, an adaptive se- lector chooses among the resulting pipelines using completed forecasts under similar con- ditions. translated_title: TIMERSI：迈向时间序列基础模型的自改进智能体化部署
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型具有强大的零样本预测能力，但在真实应用中的部署仍需针对具体任务设计模型的输入与输出。直接推理可能无法利用领域知识，也无法解决反复出现的预测误差，而定制的流水线则需要大量的人类专业知识与精力。我们提出了TIMERSI，一个围绕冻结预测模型构建的自改进智能体化部署系统。一个编码智能体将任务描述转化为可执行的流水线修改，并在历史预测窗口上测试每次修改，利用观察到的误差指导后续修改。在部署阶段，自适应选择器根据相似条件下已完成的预测，在多个候选流水线中进行选择。在TIME和FEV-bench的198个任务上，TIMERSI在六项点预测与概率预测指标上超越了所有提交的方法。受控比较进一步验证了其设计的价值。
tldr: TIMERSI是一个围绕冻结时间序列基础模型的自改进智能体部署系统，由编码智能体根据任务描述迭代生成并修正预测流水线，并在部署时通过自适应选择器挑选最优流水线，在198个任务上超越了所有对比方法。
en_tdlr: TIMERSI is a self-improving agentic deployment system around frozen time-series foundation models, where a coding agent iteratively generates and refines forecasting pipelines guided by observed errors, and an adaptive selector picks the best pipeline at deployment, outperforming all submissions across 198 tasks on TIME and FEV-bench.
